curatedMovie.curiosityHook: How will Véronique and Weronika navigate two individual lives shaped by similar ambitions?
curatedMovie.description: Two unrelated young women—one living in France, the other in Poland—share identical faces and vocal ambitions, tracing parallel lives shaped by music, intuition, and chance.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Lyrical, slow-paced, and deeply introspective; an absorbing art-house fantasy ideal for solitary, quiet viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This drama-fantasy follows two unrelated women with matching appearances and musical ambitions through separate lives.
